lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spot clusters are organized into approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. The spatial distribution follows a regular grid pattern with vertical inter-spot distances being tighter than horizontal inter-column distances.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, acting as axes for the primary spot clusters. Intersection nodes exhibit the highest local pixel intensity, forming a defined rectangular grid across the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are present on the flank; the primary ridge displays a strong vertical luminance gradient, with bright superior surfaces and shadowed inferior edges, extending from the post-branchial region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple Echeneidae (remora) individuals is localized near the ventral-pectoral junction.
